The update is real and the tree is sound: KAIF 2.7 is stamped, the deployed core is the sha256-pinned release asset, my own bundle-vs-disk sweep (no skips, owner documents included) finds no undelivered 2.7 line except six `description:` alias tails and the owner's Russian creed, and nothing the owner wrote lost a character. Fix F1-F6 before the commit.

## Findings against the executor

**F1 - "byte-equal" is wider than the observation (claim-wider-than-the-observation).** The report's lead sentence, s3 ("sandbox pass byte-equal to the live pass"), s4.5 and STATUS.md ("бой побайтно равен репетиции") assert byte equality of the passes. Observed: only the TASK file is byte-identical. `git archive HEAD | tar -x` under `core.autocrlf=true` produced a CRLF tree; the live framework files are LF. PHILOSOPHY.md 17 554 B vs 17 297 B; the two `deploy-manifest.json` differ in 210 of 252 `shas`. No verdict changed (0 mismatches, equal counters), so the tree is fine - the sentence is not. The executor measured line endings in this very session (R4a) and had the means to know. Fix: "identical counters, byte-identical task file, logs differ by 3 lines; trees equal modulo line endings (rehearsal tree CRLF, live LF)" in the report and in STATUS.md - and keep it as a field datum for the origin: a rehearsal tree made by `git archive` on Windows does not have the real tree's bytes.

**F2 - standing falsehood in STATUS.md.** The open-bugs paragraph says "Тикеты по самому фреймворку ... **Открыт один:** KAIF#72". #73 is OPEN upstream and the same file names it at line 40. Fix: "Открыты два: #72 ... и #73 (`bugs/KAIF/04_*`)".

**F3 - dead pointer in the owner's plan.** MASTER_PLAN.md decision-log row 2026-09-18: "The other 2.6-2.7 rule changes are ... listed for him in `reports/KAIF_UPDATES/KUMM_KAIF_2.7_UPDATE_REPORT.md`". `grep -n -i "policy\|rule change"` over the report: nothing is listed there. The owner-facing list is KAIF_FRAMEWORK.md s"Что изменилось в 2.7" and it covers about 10 of the 20 `policy-changes` items. The task item says "put each in front of the owner". Fix: point the row at KAIF_FRAMEWORK.md and either list all 20 there or say in words that it is a selection and where the full list is (`KAIF_UPDATE_TASK.md` is git-ignored and is deleted by `update-verify` - so the full list must live somewhere that survives).

**F4 - typed timestamps contradict the file system and GitHub (literals that look like data; the class the executor itself confessed in R4c / EXP-0119).** Ticket 03: "Correction, 2026-09-18 ≈18:35" - the file was last written 18:18:27 and the upstream comment was created 18:18:46 (15:18:46Z). Run report: "Создан: 2026-09-18 18:20" - the file was last written 18:16:15. Both times lie in the future of the write that recorded them. The lesson "a number enters a marker only after the run that produced it" was written at 18:19 and broken in the artifacts that document it. Fix: replace with observed times (`date`, the comment's `createdAt`).

**F5 - pointers to tools that exist only in a session-temporary scratchpad.** The report's appendix says two tools are "kept here as text"; it holds a FILLS fragment plus three comment lines for `merge-skills.mjs` and a prose description of `probe-matchfills.mjs` - neither source. Yet EXP-0118 (Repro and Mechanization: "merge them with the script in the field report"), ticket 04 ("`merge-skills.mjs` in the 2.7 field report"), STATUS.md ("приборы в полевом отчёте 2.7") and EXP-0117 send the next session there. Run report s6 also claims the field report carries "дословный вывод прогона 1" in its rakes section - `grep "недоехавших\|сверено файлов"` over the report: 0 hits. Fix: commit the two scripts (3.1 KB and 1.3 KB) next to the guard or paste their full sources into the appendix; correct run-report s6.

**F6 - `review-news` checkpointed while the canon still orders the opposite of a 2.7 rule.** AGENT_GUIDE.md:948-951 ("Filing tickets upstream ... `gh issue create` ... it needs their word (an `AUTH:` line)") and the tools-table row at :968 contradict the carve-out at :374-378 and :706, which this session exercised twice. The paragraph predates the update (2026-08-15), but policy item [2.7] SD is exactly this, and 2.7's own text says why it matters: "a narrow exception written away from the rule it excepts does not hold". Fix: rewrite both places to `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs report bugs/KAIF/NN_*.md` under the standing authorization.

**F7 - lesson repeated without a mechanism.** EXP-0119 calls itself the "second strike of EXP-0029"; EXP-0029 calls itself "the fourth facet" of the class (EXP-0002, -0004, -0012), and the owner's memory carries the same note. The entry closes with `none-cheap:` and "it is proposed to him" - `grep -rl PreToolUse` finds the proposal nowhere but inside that sentence (no `ideas/` doc, no STATUS line). Under the rule this update deployed, the legal fates are `mechanized:` or a `<!-- class-ok: ... -->` declaration beside the class list; the lint is silent only because the older entries carry no `class:`. The entry also files three different failures (byte counting, heredoc escaping, a marker typed before the run) under one slug, `shell-lied`, although `escaping-layer` and `claim-before-evidence` are in the list. Fix: file the hook proposal where the owner reads proposals, write the class declaration (or build the hook), split or re-class the entry.

**F8 - no `REAL WORLD:` line under "Final state".** The judge skill names "a deployed framework tree carrying the owner's own edits" as production. The substance is mostly present (live tree verified: sweep 0, check green, nothing-lost diff), but one item is not verified on the real path and is only called "advisory debt": the 2.7 `/end-chat-soft` now ends at `check --gate-budgets`, which exits 1 on this tree today (row 26) - the next soft close WILL stop there. Fix: add the difference line and name that door as the known stop.

**F9 - nits.** (a) interview 001 header: "см. раздел «Снято» в конце документа" - the section stands mid-document, above Q2. (b) "an English rendering" on the owner quote is an inference, not the source's word - say "as quoted in English by the 2.7 update task". (c) the report's Sweep row and ticket 03 show the tool's Russian output translated into English inside code formatting; numbers right, strings not verbatim. (d) the quoted guard-lint line drops its second half. (e) the `baton` census omits four new files that quote the defect (KAIF_FRAMEWORK.md, ticket 03, the report, the sweep tool). (f) ticket 04: "the three loop skills were exactly template + fills" - nightloop also carried one local `handover` line in another module; the per-module mechanism is unaffected. (g) the cited scrub run covers tracked files only; the 14 new untracked files were outside it (I checked them: clean; the pre-commit hook will too). (h) scope: the map gained rows for pre-existing `tools/scrub-identity.mjs`, `tools/`, `games/` - harmless drive-by. (i) STATUS.md says "KAIF обновлён" with no "pending: judge -> field-report -> update-verify -> commit" line; if this session dies now, the next one reads a finished update over an uncommitted 163-entry tree with `KAIF.md` and `KAIF-LOADER.mjs` still in the root.

- `checkpoint stale-claims` "scan ran clean", `sync`, `update-verify` - they write; not re-run.
- `review.mjs <interview> --check` - its path runs a recovery step that may write; not re-run. By reading: the former Q1 heading no longer parses as a question.
- `merge-skills.mjs` "prints `=` for all seven" - the script writes preview files; replaced by row 10, which shows the same equality independently.
- Byte-for-byte equality of the delivered issue bodies with the local tickets - spot-checked by grep only.
- `~/.claude/settings.json` was modified at 17:55:24 and parallel KAIF updates ran in two sibling projects at 17:58-17:59 - not attributable to this executor from here.

## Recommended action

1. Fix the text defects F1-F6 (six small edits, no machinery), then F4's two timestamps and F9a-b in the same pass; re-run `node tools/kaif-update-sweep.mjs ...` (must stay 0) and `node .kaif/kaif-core.mjs check`.
2. Post F1's corrected wording as the field report's deviation line; it is a real datum for the origin, not an embarrassment.
3. Decide F7 in writing (proposal filed + class declaration, or the hook).
4. Then: `checkpoint judge --verdict-file <this file>` -> quote this verdict in report s5 -> `checkpoint field-report` -> `update-verify` -> one commit. Do not push before the owner sees F3's list.
